newsitem.title: BELGIUM: MOSANE TAKES STAKE IN SURVEILLANCE FIRM.
newsitem.headline: MOSANE TAKES STAKE IN SURVEILLANCE FIRM.

text.p: Belgian holding company Mosane said on Thursday it planned, via a capital increase, to take a 26 percent stake in electronic surveillance firm S.A. All-tag Security.
All-tag specialises in the development and production of electronic anti-theft circuits that can be attached to goods and set off alarms when taken through detectors placed at shop exits.
The capital increase will allow All-tag to double its capacity to 400 million circuits a year, Mosane said in a statement.
Total demand for these circuits is expected to rise to 20 billion circuits per year by the year 2000.
